units.source_text: 冷泉院当了上皇之后，果如他所预期，自由自在，出入无所拘束。

en.t: After Reizei-in became Retired Emperor, everything was just as he had expected: he was free and at ease, with no restrictions on his comings and goings.

units.source_text: 让位之后，心情愉快，生涯确是幸福。

en.t: After yielding the throne, his spirits were light, and his life was indeed happy.

units.source_text: 新帝即位之后，常常挂念他的妹妹三公主。

en.t: After the new Emperor ascended the throne, he often thought with concern of his younger sister, the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 世人也普遍地尊敬这位公主。

en.t: People in general also held this princess in great respect.

units.source_text: 只是她不能胜过紫夫人的威势。

en.t: Yet she could not surpass Lady Murasaki in influence and prestige.

units.source_text: 紫夫人与源氏的恩爱，与日俱增，两人之间绝无不快之事，也无一点隔阂。

en.t: The love between Lady Murasaki and Genji grew deeper day by day, and there was no unhappiness between them, nor the slightest estrangement.

units.source_text: 但紫夫人对源氏说：“我现在不想再过这种烦杂的生涯了，但愿闲居静处，悉心修道。

en.t: But Lady Murasaki said to Genji, "I no longer wish to live such a troublesome life. I only want to withdraw to a quiet place and devote myself fully to religious practice.

units.source_text: 活到这年龄，世间悲欢荣辱，均已阅尽。

en.t: Having lived to this age, I have already seen all the sorrows and joys, honors and humiliations of the world.

units.source_text: 请你体谅我心，许我出家。”

en.t: Please understand my heart and allow me to become a nun."

units.source_text: 她常常恳切要求。

en.t: She often made this earnest request.

units.source_text: 源氏总是答道：“你这想法全没道理，也太无情了。

en.t: Genji always replied, "This idea of yours makes no sense at all, and it is far too heartless.

units.source_text: 我自己早就深望出家，但念你独留在世间，何等孤寂。

en.t: I myself have long deeply wished to renounce the world, but I think how lonely it would be if you were left behind here alone.

units.source_text: 且我出家之后，你的生涯势必变样。

en.t: Besides, after I took vows, your life would inevitably change.

units.source_text: 为此放心不下，迁延至今尚未实行。

en.t: Because this has weighed on my mind, I have put it off until now and still have not carried it out.

units.source_text: 且待我此志成遂之后，你再作打算可也。”

en.t: Wait until this wish of mine has been fulfilled; after that, you may make your own plans."

units.source_text: 他屡次阻止她。

en.t: Again and again, he held her back.

units.source_text: 明石女御孝顺紫夫人，全同对生身母亲一样。

en.t: The Akashi Consort was devoted to Lady Murasaki just as if she were her own birth mother.

units.source_text: 明石夫人则在暗中照顾女御，态度谦逊，这反而使她前程稳固，生涯幸福。

en.t: Lady Akashi, for her part, looked after the Consort quietly from behind the scenes and behaved with humility, which in fact secured her future and made her life happy.

units.source_text: 女御的外祖母老尼姑庆喜之余，动辄忍不住流泪。

en.t: The Consort's maternal grandmother, the old nun, was so overjoyed that she could not help shedding tears at every little thing.

units.source_text: 眼泪不知不觉地落下，她竟把两眼揩得通红。

en.t: Tears fell before she knew it, and she ended up rubbing both eyes bright red.

units.source_text: 这正是长命幸福的一个好例。

en.t: This was truly a fine example of living long enough to find happiness.
